scope: Primary-source endpoint check of the seven model-correction topics in the supplied critique; not an independent novelty review or replication of all experiments.

review.inputs: UTR sequence, positional/sequence annotations and categorical cell-line condition channels in the inspected multitask predictor configuration.
review.outputs: Reporter-activity features mass_center and diff; the latter represents deviation from the across-context activity mean. A separate stability task uses RNA/gDNA.
review.context_limit: Explicit cell identity does not establish prediction for arbitrary untrained cell types; categorical identity is not a measured cellular-state vector.
review.endpoint_limit: Post-transcriptional reporter activity can include stability and abundance effects; do not relabel as translation rate per RNA. RNA/gDNA is an abundance/stability proxy, not directly measured time-course half-life.
review.publication_status: The cited 2024.12.31.630783 version is a preprint.

primary_checks.supports: Condition2Tensor; cell_type field; conditions feature; default mass_center/diff targets; inspected live code.
Code-cell source explicitly configures sequence, positional and conditions features.
Code-cell source computes mass_center as count-weighted bin position and diff as mass_center minus its sequence-group mean; zscore is a separate derived field.
Primary preprint: six-cell-line UTR reporter experiments and selected linear-mRNA validation; browser search content inspected, direct open encountered CAPTCHA.

review.decision: Accept transformed-Ribo-seq correction; retain experimental validation separately.
review.inputs: CDS/codon sequence, mRNA abundance and RNA-seq-derived cellular expression profile.
review.outputs: Translation-model target is ln(5 * Ribo-seq RPKM + 1); the framework separately uses an MFE surrogate and synonymous codon optimization.
review.endpoint_limit: Ribosome-profiling abundance is not RNA-normalized TE, absolute protein yield or a direct per-RNA production rate. Measured tRNA supply is not an explicit model input.
review.experimental_scope_limit: Preferential linear-mRNA expression comparisons and separate modified/circular-RNA output validation must not be merged into demonstrated circRNA cell selectivity.

primary_checks.supports: Live requests HTML: Methods specifies ln(RPKM times 5 plus 1) for Ribo-seq/RNA-seq; Discussion identifies Ribo-seq RPKM target and abundance input.

review.decision: Accept fixed-context multitask-output distinction, with supervised transfer-learning qualification.
review.inputs: Full mRNA sequence split into UTR/CDS regions or full sequence plus region-length/frame annotations.
review.outputs: TE predictions for context outputs learned during training.
review.context_limit: Standard author inference instructions require sequence/region information, not a measured cell-state vector. Author implementation also provides transfer learning; do not claim the model can never adapt to a new context.

primary_checks.supports: Live README input schema, pretrained human/mouse multitask prediction and separate transfer-learning workflow; example training TEs explicitly fake.
Primary-paper architecture and TE endpoint reference; full paper not independently re-extracted in this bounded check.

review.inputs: Transcript-region sequences and learned tissue-context embedding; target-context labeled support examples during adaptation.
review.outputs: TE prediction in the modeled/adapted tissue context.
review.context_limit: Principal few-shot adaptation uses labeled target-domain examples to update context embedding. The study also evaluates mean-source zero-shot inference; do not erase that comparator or imply all inference requires new labels.

primary_checks.supports: Primary full-text search retrieval: support-set sizes 10/50/100/150; N=50 main operating point; labeled target-domain supervision and separate zero-shot comparison. Direct page open encountered publisher redirect error.

review.inputs: IRES RNA sequence, through an IRES-fine-tuned RNA language model and dependency mapping.
review.endpoint_limit: The accompanying experiment profiles 96 full-length IRESes in circRNA reporters across six cell lines. Those measured activity profiles are an atlas; they are not the learned model's cell-specific translation outputs.

primary_checks.supports: Primary full text inspected in preceding current-session check: abstract, atlas section and model dependency-mapping section clearly separate functional profiling from structural prediction.

review.decision: Accept protein-feature classifier and forced-recruitment qualification.
review.outputs: RBP activator/nonactivator classification based on reporter-screen labels.
review.experimental_scope_limit: The screening assay uses candidate RBP tethering to a circRNA reporter. Activity after forced recruitment does not establish natural binding to arbitrary RNAs or cell specificity. The paper separately validates selected cognate-binding and IRES/protein contexts.
review.context_limit: Not an RNA-plus-cellular-RBP-abundance predictor of circRNA output across cell types.

primary_checks.supports: Live requests HTML: luciferase circRNA reporter plus tethered RBP library; PUF tethering; RNA and luciferase measurements; separate recruited endogenous-factor validation.
Author repository describes sparse PLS-DA protein-feature classification; classification directory inspected via GitHub API.

review.inputs: 201-nucleotide sequence window with marked candidate adenosine.
review.outputs: Edited/not-edited site classification or positive-class probability/score at a specified threshold-defined task.
review.endpoint_limit: Principal GTEx-liver task uses a 15-percent editing threshold; class probability is not predicted molecular editing fraction, sensor activation or basal leak.

primary_checks.supports: Primary research-paper abstract inspected through search: 201-nt candidate windows, GTEx liver n=131 and principal 15-percent classification task.
Author README explicitly frames binary classification, threshold groups and positive-label inference probability.

review.decision: Accept circRNA translation-probability correction; avoid implying absolute yield or causal modification effects.
review.inputs: Modification-related features centered on base-resolution m6A-site information.
review.outputs: Estimated modification/site contributions and circRNA translation probability through learned features and random-forest classification.
review.endpoint_limit: Not absolute protein yield, translation rate per RNA or output for a specified target cell. Learned contribution scores are not experimentally proven causal effects of installing/removing modifications.
review.input_evidence_limit: Primary abstract establishes modification-feature and probability tasks; exact implementation schema and any latent cell-specific stratification were not independently inspected. Do not add an explicit cell-context input absent source verification.

primary_checks.supports: Primary paper abstract inspected in current session: convolutional modification features, BiGRU site contributions and random-forest circRNA translation probability.

shared_conclusion: Keep reporter activity, RNA abundance, ribosome occupancy, RNA-normalized TE, editing-site class probability, structure prediction, coding/translation potential and protein output distinct. These endpoint checks do not establish broad research novelty.
